label: Plotinus, Enneads V.4.1, τὸ γὰρ μὴ πρῶτον...…: What is not simple needs the simples within it in…
locator: V.4.1, τὸ γὰρ μὴ πρῶτον ... ἵν’ ᾖ ἐξ ἐκείνων
interpretation: Source reading recorded in prose only. The explicit reason for excluding a nonsimple first is recorded. Constitutive need supplies neither the identity of a particular proper component nor an actual efficient cause unless those further interfaces are defended.
